classification: Simulation compatibility identification, not hardware calibration; no parameter adoption implied

reference.raw_waveform: Not saved by original search; new replay is labeled regenerated, not recovered original data
reference.contact_scope: Historical loader applies material/offsets but no modern group filter. Record internal manifold count separately from active impulses; no external environment/support.

family.basis: Effort scale derives from approved spring and accepted old raw excursion, NOT coefficient0.1 interpreted as Nm and NOT diagnostic0.002Nm. Viscous scale derives from existing documented damping. Fractions/multipliers are a finite declared compatibility family, not a measured confidence interval; static range also remains below k*(.1deg)/sqrt2 necessary two-axis centering torque budget.
family.viscous_sensitivity_basis: Before any candidate run, extend sensitivity coverage using historical root angular-speed peak8.9443798065rad/s, torque frequencies up to8Hz, documented numerical effective tilt inertia0.8e-6kgm2 and q_ref=.00310958rad. I*(2*pi*8*omega_peak)/(2*pi*6*q_ref) is order.0031Nms/rad, about13*existingD;16*D covers this rough scale. This is a declared simulation search range, not an identified mechanical value or guaranteed bound.

selection.eligible: Historical replay peak matches old aggregate within10%; candidate raw peak<=original0.01 shake bound, finite state and no nonzero contact response
selection.score: Mean squared difference between new/old per-tick four tilt q normalized by23deg, using regenerated waveform only if replay gate passed
selection.tie: Within1% score choose lower static, then lower dynamic, then lower viscosity
selection.freeze: Freeze selected configuration SHA before original acceptance; if no eligible candidate or replay gate fails, do not invent selected values or tune family from T1-T4 scores.
